values.note: 24 non-electric single sites (numbered 1-25, no 14), each with tent pad, fire grate, bear locker and table. Vehicles must fit the parking spur; maximum vehicle length 30 ft. The forest's status table says 26 sites.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/idlewild-campground ('This campground has 24 non-electric sites that will accommodate tents, trailers and RVs'; 'Maximum Vehicle Length: 30''') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10311402 (same 30-ft notice) + catalog 10311402 (24 RV NONELECTRIC sites) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Idlewild: 26 sites, Max Spur 30'), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/idlewild-campground ('24 non-electric sites') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10311402 ('RV water connections are not available. Come with your water tank filled') + catalog 10311402 (all RV NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup 'No'), read 2026-10-28

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/idlewild-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site'), read 2026-10-28

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Sulphur Ranger District Campground Status, Idlewild Operating Season 'May 22 - Sept 20'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 15 sites reservable, 9 first-come (1, 4-6, 10-13, 17). A reserved site must be occupied by noon the day after arrival or it is released.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/idlewild-campground ('There are first-come, first-serve sites and reservable sites') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10311402 ('This campground has a 14 day stay limit'; occupancy notice) + /rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-19) + catalog reservable flags, read 2026-10-28

values.note: $29 a site, one vehicle included; $8 a night for each extra vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/idlewild-campground ('Single Site: $29 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10311402/rates (2026 Peak Season RV 29) + notice ('Any additional vehicles will be charged $8.00 per vehicle per night'), read 2026-10-28

note: Sulphur RD (Arapaho NF) campground beside US-40 a mile south of Winter Park, at 9,000 ft in lodgepole near the upper Fraser River; the paved Fraser River Trail runs nearby to Winter Park and Fraser. --Claude
summary: FS page + ARP status table + recreation.gov: confirmed 24 non-electric sites, no water hookups, $29, reservable with some first-come.
